# grepr_data_warehouse_integration (Resource)

Manages a Grepr-managed data warehouse integration, which stores datasets in Grepr's own storage.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grepr_data_warehouse_integration" "main" {
  name = "production_warehouse"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Integration name.

### Optional

- `team_ids` (Set of String) Team IDs with access. Omit to keep the current teams; an empty set clears them.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the integration.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `version` (Number) Integration version used for optimistic locking.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import grepr_data_warehouse_integration.main INTEGRATION_ID
```
